$comment: Column map of a Geant4 run (simulation-columns/1; geant4 adapter 0.2.0, Geant4 program A2.5; owner adapters/geant4, versioned by column_map_version). layered_sim writes column_map.json next to its CSV for every run. Per column: the semantic name the study layer reads, the actual column name, unit, operational definition and the file it lives in (csv or summary; from adapter 0.3.0 also root, with the ntuple of element_sim's per-event ROOT file). Only declarative operations: rename, unit conversion, sum, filter; a transformation that needs computation is a separate, recorded step. Validated by the adapter's scripts with contracts.schema.validate.

ntuple.description: with file root: the ntuple of the per-event ROOT file (element_sim.events/1) the column lives in
